description: This file defines the DataMatrixImage class responsible for generating DataMatrix barcode images, including encoding, placement, and rendering logic in C# within the PdfSharp.Drawing.BarCodes namespace.

classes.name: DataMatrixImage
classes.description: Class responsible for generating DataMatrix barcode images, encoding data, placing ECC200 bits, and rendering the barcode as an image.

methods.name: GenerateMatrixImage
methods.description: Static method to create a DataMatrix image from text, encoding, size, and brush.

methods.name: DrawMatrix
methods.description: Creates and returns an XImage representing the DataMatrix barcode.

methods.name: DataMatrix
methods.description: Encodes the input text into a DataMatrix grid of modules.

methods.name: Iec16022Ecc200
methods.description: Encodes data with ECC200 error correction and returns the data matrix placement grid.

methods.name: Ecc200Encode
methods.description: Encodes the barcode data using DataMatrix ECC200 encoding scheme.

methods.name: State255
methods.description: Calculates padding byte values for ECC200 encoding.

methods.name: Ecc200Placement
methods.description: Places data bits into the DataMatrix grid according to ECC200 specification.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementBit
methods.description: Places individual bits into the placement grid.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementBlock
methods.description: Places a block of placement bits into the grid.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementCornerA
methods.description: Handles special placement of bits in corner case A.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementCornerB
methods.description: Handles special placement of bits in corner case B.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementCornerC
methods.description: Handles special placement of bits in corner case C.

methods.name: Ecc200PlacementCornerD
methods.description: Handles special placement of bits in corner case D.

methods.name: Ecc200
methods.description: Calculates and appends Reed-Solomon error correction code to the data.

methods.name: InitGalois
methods.description: Initializes Galois field for Reed-Solomon encoding.

methods.name: EncodeReedSolomon
methods.description: Performs Reed-Solomon encoding on data blocks.

methods.name: CreateImage
methods.description: Creates a GDI+ bitmap or WPF image of the DataMatrix code based on the grid.
